title: Keeping the Ball Rolling: Fullerene-like Molecular Clusters
claim: Structural topology is better established in this surveyed field than the bonding interactions and useful properties of the fullerene-like clusters.
explanation: The authors describe their treatment as restricted to core topology and call for further work on diverse, complex bonding situations and potential functions, particularly for mixed-valent Al and Ga clusters.
scope: The three families of fullerene-like molecular clusters surveyed by the review.
caveats: The review mentions magnetic and other property opportunities but does not establish a general topology–property relationship.
